summary: Retire failed step resource scopes before retries and show retry policies and attempt deadlines in missions show

replay.detail: Retries retire earlier attempts' queued and admitted lane memberships rather than reusing grants. Inherited parent scopes remain owned by the parent.

schema.detail: Step run views optionally include the declared retry policy; absent policies are omitted.

rules.detail: Automatic and operator retries cannot dispatch a new program attempt or admit a new direct execution until earlier scopes of the same logical step have retired, including across reopened run generations.

compatibility.detail: Retry admission rejoins the lane queue with a new attempt identity. Existing retry policy fields and failure classification remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart or data migration is required.

manual.detail: External flock tickets are outside native lane custody and must be released by the owning process exiting.

recovery.detail: Pending or uncertain retirement retains custody and blocks retry dispatch until execution roots and linked children have terminated.
